en.headline: Police appeal for information on 77-year-old man missing in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Chow Wah-shun was last seen on Monday afternoon in Tsing Yeung Street; officers described him as 1.68 metres tall with short white hair.
body: Police are appealing for public help to locate a 77-year-old man who went missing in Tuen Mun on Monday.
Officers said Chow Wah-shun was last seen in the afternoon in Tsing Yeung Street. His family reported him missing the same day.

The man is about 1.68 metres tall and weighs around 52 kilograms, with a thin build, pointed face, yellow skin and short white hair. When last seen he was wearing a black top, black trousers, a brown jacket and black shoes.
Anyone with information or who has seen him is asked to contact police.

zh.headline: 77歲男子疑在屯門失蹤 警方呼籲提供資料
zh.dek: 鄒華順周一下午最後在青楊街露面，身高約1.68米，蓄短白髮，警方呼籲市民提供線索。
body: 警方呼籲市民提供一名在屯門失蹤的77歲男子的消息。
警方指，鄒華順昨日下午在青楊街最後露面後便告失蹤，家人同日報案。
他身高約1.68米，體重約52公斤，瘦身材，尖面型，黃皮膚及蓄短白髮。最後露面時身穿黑色上衣、黑色長褲、啡色外套及黑色鞋。
任何人如有該失蹤男子的消息或曾見過他，請與警方聯絡。
